commits.subject: H1(O(D + nF)) VANISHES FOR LARGE n IN AJC -- the antecedent my r3 measured as unwitnessed
commits.summary:
**The theorem.** For a finite dominant pi : Y -> P1 and any Weil divisor D, H1(O(D + n F)) is subsingleton for all large n. Route: the two-cover Cech H1 of the twisted sheaf is N / A_n for the FIXED ambient N = O(D)(V0 inf V1), the ladder A_n increases and exhausts N, and N/A_0 is finite-dimensional by the devissage -- so Noetherian stabilization forces A_n = top eventually. Per-D n0, no duality, no R^1 f_*.

**What it closes.** My r3 landed DegreeVanishing.lean conditional on Subsingleton H1(O_X) and then measured that AJC witnesses that antecedent at NO proper curve -- the sole producer carried [IsAffine X], which a proper curve never satisfies. This supplies a base vanishing on a real curve bundle, so that conditional layer stops resting on something the project cannot produce.

**Scope, stated in the file.** This is SINGLE-FIELD vanishing in the twist direction of one pi. It is NOT extension-uniformity (nothing in either project has that; the AJCR analogue transports facts one field at a time because the ledger constants are per-field Classical.choose values) and NOT global generation (proved separately off the devissage slice). The module docstring separates the three explicitly.

**Provenance.** AJCR RiemannRoch/FLVVanishing.lean, bodies unchanged; the mathematics is AJCRs, argument and all. AJCs contribution is the carrier substitution that removes the Picard cone. Kernel-checked, 8597 jobs, exit 0, zero style warnings, zero sorries.
